name: com.tealeaf.procedural-animation.dots
description: 2D grounded procedural appendage animation for Unity DOTS.

samples.description: The teaching lab: an authored creature, lesson terrain and moving-support adapters, and line-renderer presentation.
The top-down slice: a hexapod on a movement plane with heading-relative homes, a planar foothold query, tripod cadence, an explicit recovery hand-off, and filtered body language.
